body:
Hi @MatthewRuddy thanks for opening this issues.

The data organization is misleading here. In the Helper (the library that handles the state of the search inside InstantSearch.js), there is an option for naming a group of attributes as a "hierarchical facet". Since this option is technical in instantsearch.js, we didn't choose to expose it. Instead we use the first attribute as the name of the hierarchical facet.

Your state is perfectly normal.

Hope that answers your question.
